Thanks for the questions and for starting the vendor creation. Confirmations below and a short checklist to complete vendor setup from our side:

- Remit email: invoices@redwood.com
- Primary contact: Finance Ops <finance.ops@redwood.com>
- Bank account: ACH details included in onboarding packet (please use your secure portal to capture these).

PO / payment policy:
- Helio-required PO: Redwood prefers to have a PO for each invoice, and our billing system writes the PO into the header. For recurring or subscription charges we need the PO at time of invoice.

VAT / tax handling: 
- If Helio uses reverse charge for EU customers, please provide the self-billing agreement or the legal instruction and we will coordinate with tax counsel. In general, Redwood will provide VAT registration evidence for EU-registered legal entities; self-billing requires a signed agreement.

Next steps:
1) Please create the vendor record and reply with the Helio vendor ID.
2) If you need our bank details captured directly in a secure vendor portal, send the portal link and a secure upload method.
3) If Helio requires a DocuSign for self-billing or PO acceptance, we can sign — here's a suggested DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/vendor-enroll-helio-2028
